text_block_list.name: Cameraman
text_block_list.text:
—Oh, looking good, City-chan!
Now give me a more relaxed feel...

text_block_list.name: Cameraman
text_block_list.text:
Exactly! City-chan just hanging out around the academy
feels like getting a peek at the real her... it's the best!

text_block_list.name: Cameraman
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, I'm gonna go check a few things real quick,
so let's take a break!

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: Okaaay.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: Same to you. You don't tag along for shoots like this very often, right? How's it feel?

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: Well, I'm a pro after all.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: “Still, doing a shoot at the academy we usually go to feels kind of strange...”

It all started a few days ago, when Gold City asked me
to act as a liaison to get permission
for a photo shoot at the academy.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: The magazine where I'm an exclusive model said they're gonna do a special feature on my debut.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: And they also want shots that capture daily life at Tracen Academy...
choice_data_list: Got it, I'll check on it!

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Thanks. I'll let the editor know
to contact you.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
If you're interested, you're welcome to watch.
Honestly, we're just shooting some footage though.

—And so, wanting to see what she was like
at work, I ended up observing her photoshoot.

text_block_list.name: Filming Staff
text_block_list.text:
Trainer!
Thank you so much for today~!
Thanks to you, this is going to make for a wonderful special feature!

text_block_list.name: Filming Staff
text_block_list.text:
Maybe it's because her Trainer is here,
but City-chan's expression is so much softer than usual!

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
No way, that's not it at all.
This guy has nothing to do with it. Seriously.

text_block_list.name: Filming Staff
text_block_list.text:
You're totally in denial!
I've been watching you since your kid-model days, City-chan, but you feel softer than ever today, you know~?
Fitting for an exclusive model, Gold City carries a very relaxed air when she's around the staff.
However—

text_block_list.name: Filming Staff
text_block_list.text: Still, City-chan really is incredible, isn't she?

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: ? What about it?

text_block_list.name: Filming Staff
text_block_list.text: "Because she's already amazing as a model, yet she still wants to run in the Twinkle Series!"

text_block_list.name: Filming Staff
text_block_list.text:
I wonder if constantly challenging herself
is the secret to City-chan's beauty?

text_block_list.name: Filming Staff
text_block_list.text:
Everyone in the editorial department looks up to you, City-chan.
You're popular as a model, yet you're so stoic about constantly honing yourself.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Ah... Thank you.
Though, I don't run just to polish myself.

text_block_list.name: Filming Staff
text_block_list.text: I know. You told me before that you wanted to detach yourself from being a model for a bit, right?

text_block_list.name: Filming Staff
text_block_list.text:
“Doesn't that just mean you want to refine ‘Gold City’
even further? You've always had that monk-like mindset, after all.”

text_block_list.name: Filming Staff
text_block_list.text:
"I know you'll be able to put everything you gained
from running to good use in your future, City-chan.
I'm rooting for you!"

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: No. The reason I run is—

text_block_list.name: Filming Staff
text_block_list.text:
...?
What's wrong?

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
No...
I was just thinking that it felt nice to be praised.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: I'm... happy. Haha.
choice_data_list: (Her voice is trembling just a little...)

text_block_list.text:
Was it frustration, or was it sadness? Perhaps she was hurt
that the running she devoted herself to wholeheartedly
was treated as a mere sideshow.
Once I realized that—I couldn't just stay silent.
choice_data_list: Please watch only how she runs

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
...Huh?
Trainer...?
choice_data_list: City runs for the sake of the "now"

text_block_list.name: Filming Staff
text_block_list.text: H-Huuuh...?
choice_data_list: You'll understand if you watch the race. Please come!

text_block_list.name: Filming Staff
text_block_list.text:
Ah, yes. Why, of course...
Our editorial department is going, though...?

text_block_list.name: Filming Staff
text_block_list.text:
...Um, shall we resume the photoshoot?
Time's ticking. City-chan, are you ready?

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: Yes. I'm all right.

text_block_list.name: Filming Staff
text_block_list.text:
Well then, Trainer.
Please watch over me again!

text_block_list.name: Filming Staff
text_block_list.text: ...Did I just step on a landmine?

text_block_list.name: Filming Staff
text_block_list.text:
—Well, thanks for your hard work today!
Look forward to the issue~!

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: Thank you very much.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
...Trainer.
About what you were saying during the break.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: "...Good, as long as you get it. She's someone who takes good care of me, so don't freak her out too much."
choice_data_list: Still, I didn't want to see you smile so weakly.
Still, I didn't want to see you smile so weakly.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: ...So you knew all along.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Not like I don't know it's out of pure goodwill.
In fact, I know you respect me, too.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: Considering how things have been up to now, it makes sense people think my running's just a bonus.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, I get it. Even without someone
protecting me so unnaturally, I can stand on my own two feet.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
"...Or so I thought.
It was actually pretty shocking after all."

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
"Even someone who's watched over me closely since I was little
and has always been so good to me..."

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
"I guess... my feelings
never got through to them."
choice_data_list: Let's convey your feelings to everyone through your running.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Even without your encouragement,
that was my plan from the start.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
...Still, it's already gotten through to you, huh.
Loud and clear.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
"It's nothing, really.
Let's go train!"
